_vad_comment: VAD (Voice Activity Detection) parameters - tune these if speech is being filtered out

tiny.en.description: English-only tiny model, slightly better for English

small.description: Good balance of speed and accuracy (244M params)

distil-large-v3.description: Distilled large-v3: near-best accuracy at 6x speed (756M params) - RECOMMENDED

compute_types.int8: Fastest on CPU, good GPU performance (default)
compute_types.int8_float16: int8 weights with float16 compute (GPU only)
compute_types.float16: Standard GPU precision, more accurate than int8
compute_types.float32: Full precision, required for some CPUs/GPUs

options.language: Language code: en, es, fr, de, etc. or 'auto' for detection

_comment5: VAD (Voice Activity Detection) tuning - adjust if speech is being incorrectly filtered

vad_options.vad_threshold: 0.0-1.0, lower = more sensitive to speech (default Silero: 0.5, we use 0.25)
vad_options.vad_min_speech_duration_ms: Minimum speech segment length in ms (default: 250, we use 100)
vad_options.vad_min_silence_duration_ms: Minimum silence before splitting segments (default: 2000, we use 1500)
vad_options.vad_speech_pad_ms: Padding around detected speech in ms (default: 400, we use 300)
